_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in your values
_comment_llm: llm_max_tokens: output budget per call (raise if you see finish_reason=length on empty responses); llm_system_prefix: prepended to the system prompt, e.g. '{REASON:ilow}'; llm_response_format: 'json_object' or 'none'; llm_json_schema: try json_schema format first with fallback (true/false)
_comment_pipeline: pipeline: 'legacy' (fixed chunks) or 'v2' (chapter-level map/reduce with character roster); also settable via --pipeline
_comment_run_history: run_history: when true (or --run-history is passed), each run mirrors metadata about itself (versions, models, prompt hashes, per-book outcomes and claim counts — never book text) to the processor schema in Supabase; uploads are best-effort and never affect the run. machine_label: an optional label you choose (e.g. your PC's name) stamped on those rows so runs from different machines are distinguishable; it is never read from the machine automatically
_comment_hardcover: hardcover: when true (or --hardcover is passed), each book's identity is resolved against Hardcover at scan time; on a confident match its canonical title, authors and series become the work record's values. hardcover_token: a Hardcover API token (create one in your Hardcover account settings), or set the HARDCOVER_TOKEN environment variable instead; the token is only ever sent to api.hardcover.app and never appears in previews or logs
_comment_series_registry: series_registry: kill-switch for the local series character registry (default true). When true, each finished book folds its shipped cast into ~/.ebook-processor/series_registry.db so later books in the same series can draw on it; the registry is derived state rebuilt from finished records, and a registry failure only ever logs a warning
